title: Sign-in email keeps its red border when invalid, after blur and on hover
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test: node --input-type=module -e "import {loginPage} from './apps/tracy-web/src/identity/pages.js'; const h=loginPage({}); process.stdout.write(typeof h==='string'?h:await h.text())" and record H = the output.

S2: Record BASE = H.indexOf('.auth-card input{background'), HOVER = H.indexOf('.auth-card input:hover:not(:focus-visible)'), BAD = H.indexOf('.auth-card input:user-invalid,.auth-card input:user-invalid:hover{border-color:var(--destructive)}').
S3 (optional, needs a browser): serve H as a file, type 'abc' in input[type=email], click outside it, and read getComputedStyle(input).borderColor; then hover it and read again.
expect: BASE >= 0 and HOVER >= 0 (the grey rules still exist; if they were renamed, update this case).
BAD > BASE and BAD > HOVER (pre-fix: BAD === -1, the grey rules won and the blurred invalid field was grey).
S3 if run: both reads equal the computed --destructive colour (dark theme on the stand: oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216)).
evidence: Measured 05/10/2026 in Chrome on loginPage() of develop eaa7e8c73: 'abc' then blur gave border oklab(0.985 0 0 / 0.1) with :user-invalid true.
fence: apps/tracy-web/src/lib/page-shell.js: the .auth-card input:user-invalid rule follows .auth-card input and its hover rule.
